items.title: Nanopore sequencing combined with adaptive sampling and NanoExpansion enables accurate characterization of repeat expansion disorders.
items.summary: Expansion repeat disorders are caused by abnormal expansions of short tandem repeats (STRs). We evaluated targeted long-read nanopore sequencing for comprehensive characterization of STR expansions in 132 participants, including patients with myotonic dystrophy type 1 (DM1, n = 51) and DM2 ( n = 3) already characterized by Southern blot, C9orf72 -associated amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS n = 11) evaluated by repeat primed polymerase chain reaction (RP-PCR; validation group), suspected spinocerebellar ataxia (SCA, n = 46), cerebellar ataxia with neuropathy and vestibular areflexia syndrome (CANVAS; n = 13), Huntington's disease (1), Kennedy disease (1), Friedreich ataxia (FRDA, 2), and 4 healthy controls (test group). Native DNA was sequenced using adaptive sampling (AS) on Oxford Nanopore GridION or PromethION-2Solo platforms. Long-PCR sequencing was performed for comparison. We also developed NanoExpansion, a Python-based tool for sizing expanded alleles and detecting sequence interruptions. We correctly characterized all DM1, DM2, ALS, FRDA, Huntington's disease, and Kennedy disease cases, and identified eight SCA27B, two SCA37, three SCA31, one SCA3, and nine CANVAS cases. Compared with the AS approach, long-PCR underestimated alleles exceeding 800 repeats. Repeat interruptions were detected in 27/51 (52.9%) DM1 cases and 1/10 (10%) ALS, but not in CANVAS, FRDA, Huntington's disease, Kennedy disease, or SCA cases. This integrated sequencing analysis pipeline provides accurate, comprehensive characterization of repeat expansion disorders and has the potential to improve routine genetic diagnosis.
items.titleZh: 纳米孔测序结合自适应采样与NanoExpansion可实现对重复扩增疾病的准确表征
items.summaryZh: 该研究评估了纳米孔长读长测序结合自适应采样和自研工具NanoExpansion，在132名参与者中准确表征多种重复扩增疾病，包括C9orf72相关ALS。结果显示该方法能正确识别所有ALS病例，并检测到重复序列中断；相比传统长PCR，其能更准确测量超长扩增。该流程有望提升重复扩增疾病的常规遗传诊断。
items.insight: 对于ALS研究者，该研究展示了纳米孔测序结合自适应采样可准确表征C9orf72重复扩增，并检测重复中断，这可能有助于更精细的基因型-表型关联分析。NanoExpansion工具的开源特性便于其他实验室整合到诊断流程中，推动ALS遗传诊断的标准化和精准化。

items.abstractZh: 重复扩增疾病由短串联重复序列（STR）的异常扩增引起。我们评估了靶向长读长纳米孔测序在132名参与者中对STR扩增进行全面表征的能力，包括已通过Southern blot表征的强直性肌营养不良1型（DM1，n=51）和DM2（n=3）患者、通过重复引物聚合酶链反应（RP-PCR）评估的C9orf72相关肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS，n=11；验证组）、疑似脊髓小脑共济失调（SCA，n=46）、伴有神经病和前庭反射消失的小脑共济失调综合征（CANVAS；n=13）、亨廷顿病（1例）、肯尼迪病（1例）、弗里德赖希共济失调（FRDA，2例）以及4名健康对照（测试组）。使用Oxford Nanopore GridION或PromethION-2Solo平台上的自适应采样（AS）对天然DNA进行测序。同时进行长PCR测序以作比较。我们还开发了NanoExpansion，一种基于Python的工具，用于确定扩增等位基因的大小并检测序列中断。我们正确表征了所有DM1、DM2、ALS、FRDA、亨廷顿病和肯尼迪病病例，并识别出8例SCA27B、2例SCA37、3例SCA31、1例SCA3和9例CANVAS病例。与AS方法相比，长PCR低估了超过800个重复的等位基因。在27/51（52.9%）的DM1病例和1/10（10%）的ALS病例中检测到重复中断，但在CANVAS、FRDA、亨廷顿病、肯尼迪病或SCA病例中未检测到。这种整合测序分析流程可对重复扩增疾病进行准确、全面的表征，并具有改善常规遗传诊断的潜力。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究近期发表于NAR Genomics and Bioinformatics，将纳米孔自适应采样测序与新型分析工具结合，提升了C9orf72相关ALS等重复扩增疾病的遗传诊断精度，具有直接的转化价值。

items.title: Enzymatic N-deacylation is the predicted membrane-disruption switch for sphingomyelin: a falsifiable in-silico framework for sphingolipid vulnerability in ALS.
items.summary: Sphingolipid dysregulation is an emerging feature of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), but no systematic method separates species that may worsen axon-myelin membrane integrity from matter that may counteract it. We present an in-silico framework classifying sphingolipids and designed derivatives as candidate membrane-disruptive or candidate protective species, scored against real biological referents using externally published tools rather than a bespoke composite. Its central finding concerns a single, chemically defined difference in lipid state. In coarse-grained (MARTINI 3) molecular dynamics with three independent replicates per system, intact palmitoyl-sphingomyelin is indistinguishable from a pure-POPC bilayer (leaflet-mean Δ thickness + 0.001 nm, 95% CI brackets zero), whereas the modeled N-deacylated form thins it in every replicate (Δ=-0.043 nm, [- 0.046, - 0.041]), tracking a lyso-phosphatidylcholine detergent control (-0.083 nm, [- 0.087, - 0.080]) on two concordant estimators. Because only one lyso-sphingolipid is parameterized in public MARTINI 3, N-deacylation is not established here as a class-wide effect. Across eleven ALS studies (2021-2026), six report elevated serine-palmitoyltransferase (SPT) pathway sphingolipids, all in monogenic SPTLC1/SPTLC2 cohorts, whereas sporadic cohorts show disturbance without a shared direction. Because the simulations do not address whether this species is produced, accumulates, or reaches pathological concentrations in ALS tissue, we present the ALS connection as hypothesis-generating rather than direct evidence. Separately, an explicitly exploratory arm reports two designed modulators with predicted target engagement (Boltz-2) and an ADMET triage of their liabilities. The primary contribution is the membrane result with a wet-lab panel that makes it falsifiable.

items.titleZh: 酶促N-脱酰化是鞘磷脂膜破坏的预测开关：一个用于ALS中鞘脂脆弱性的可证伪计算机模拟框架
items.summaryZh: 该研究用计算机模拟框架分析鞘脂对膜完整性的影响，发现鞘磷脂的N-脱酰化形式在模拟中使膜变薄，可能具有膜破坏性，而完整鞘磷脂无此效应。在ALS文献中，单基因SPTLC1/SPTLC2队列显示SPT通路鞘脂升高，但散发性ALS无一致方向。作者强调ALS关联仅为假设生成，需湿实验验证。
items.insight: 这项研究为ALS中鞘脂代谢紊乱提供了可证伪的机制假设：N-脱酰化鞘磷脂可能通过破坏膜完整性参与疾病，且明确区分了单基因与散发性ALS的鞘脂特征差异。其计算框架和湿实验验证面板为后续研究提供了可操作的验证路径，值得关注其后续实验验证结果。

items.abstractZh: 鞘脂失调是肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的一个新兴特征，但目前尚无系统方法将可能恶化轴突-髓鞘膜完整性的鞘脂种类与可能起对抗作用的物质区分开来。我们提出了一个计算机模拟框架，将鞘脂及设计衍生物分类为候选膜破坏性或候选保护性种类，并使用外部已发表的工具而非定制的复合评分，对照真实生物学参照物进行评分。其核心发现涉及脂质状态中一个化学上明确的单一差异。在粗粒化（MARTINI 3）分子动力学模拟中，每个体系进行三次独立重复，完整的棕榈酰-鞘磷脂与纯POPC双层膜无法区分（小叶平均厚度变化 +0.001 nm，95%置信区间包含零），而模拟的N-脱酰化形式在每次重复中均使其变薄（Δ=-0.043 nm，[-0.046, -0.041]），在两个一致估计量上均与溶血磷脂酰胆碱去垢剂对照（-0.083 nm，[-0.087, -0.080]）的变化趋势一致。由于公共MARTINI 3中仅有一种溶血鞘脂被参数化，N-脱酰化在此并未被确立为全类效应。在十一项ALS研究（2021-2026）中，六项报告丝氨酸棕榈酰转移酶（SPT）通路鞘脂升高，均来自单基因SPTLC1/SPTLC2队列，而散发性队列显示紊乱但无共同方向。由于模拟并未解决该种类是否在ALS组织中产生、积累或达到病理浓度的问题，我们将ALS关联作为假设生成而非直接证据呈现。另外，一个明确探索性分支报告了两种设计调节剂，具有预测的靶点结合（Boltz-2）及其 liability 的ADMET筛选。主要贡献是膜结果及使其可证伪的湿实验面板。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年发表，首次提出鞘磷脂N-脱酰化作为膜破坏开关的可证伪计算框架，直接关联ALS中鞘脂失调这一新兴特征，并为转化研究提供了明确的湿实验验证方向。

items.title: Biomarker-Guided Diagnosis of Riboflavin Transporter Deficiency Presenting as Seronegative Myasthenia Gravis: A Short Report from a Consanguineous Family.
items.summary: Brown-Vialetto-Van Laere syndrome (BVVLS) is a rare, treatable neurodegenerative disorder caused by riboflavin transporter gene variants (SLC52A2, SLC52A3). Early symptoms can mimic neuromuscular junction disorders, causing diagnostic delays. A 3.5-year-old girl from consanguineous parents presented at 2.5 years with isolated bilateral ptosis, later developing dysphagia, dysphonia, facial diplegia, stridor, and respiratory compromise. Examination revealed tongue atrophy with fasciculations and bulbar weakness but normal limb strength. Diagnosed with seronegative myasthenia gravis, she failed to respond to corticosteroids, pyridostigmine, salbutamol, and intravenous immunoglobulin. Absence of fatigability, lower motor neuron signs, and a sibling history of hearing loss and bulbar palsy prompted genetic testing revealed a homozygous missense variant in SLC52A3 (c.670T > C; p.Phe224Leu). High-dose riboflavin (up to 50 mg/kg/day) led to gradual improvement in bulbar function, resolution of stridor, and respiratory stabilization, though ptosis and tongue fasciculations persisted. This report is novel in using clinical response to riboflavin as a functional biomarker for riboflavin transporter deficiency (RTD) in a patient with a variant of uncertain significance, unlike prior cases with definitive genetics. Empiric riboflavin challenge offers a practical framework when genetic results are ambiguous. RTD should be suspected in children with treatment-resistant, non-fluctuating ptosis and bulbar weakness, particularly with consanguinity or family history of hearing loss and bulbar palsy. Early high-dose riboflavin prevents decline, while immunosuppression is ineffective and potentially harmful.

items.titleZh: 以血清阴性重症肌无力为表现的核黄素转运体缺乏症的生物标志物引导诊断：来自一个近亲婚配家庭的简短报告
items.summaryZh: 本报告描述一名近亲婚配家庭的3.5岁女童，最初表现为血清阴性重症肌无力，对多种免疫治疗无效。根据下运动神经元体征、同胞听力丧失和延髓麻痹史，基因检测发现SLC52A3纯合错义变异，诊断为核黄素转运体缺乏症。大剂量核黄素治疗后延髓功能改善、喘鸣消失、呼吸稳定，但上睑下垂和舌肌束颤动持续。作者提出，在遗传结果不明确时，核黄素激发试验可作为功能性生物标志物辅助诊断。
items.insight: 该报告提示，对于表现为治疗抵抗、非波动性上睑下垂和延髓肌无力的儿童，尤其是有近亲婚配或家族性听力丧失和延髓麻痹史者，应警惕核黄素转运体缺乏症而非重症肌无力。其提出的核黄素激发试验作为功能性生物标志物，为遗传变异意义未明时提供了一条可操作的诊断与治疗路径，对ALS及其他运动神经元病领域中“可治疗模仿者”的识别具有借鉴意义。

aiRead.keyFinding: 在SLC52A3意义未明变异患者中，大剂量核黄素治疗后的临床改善被用作核黄素转运体缺乏症的功能性生物标志物，支持经验性核黄素激发试验的诊断价值。
aiRead.limitation: 仅为单例病例报告，缺乏对照组和长期随访，核黄素反应作为生物标志物的敏感性和特异性尚未在更大队列中验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续更大规模队列研究是否验证核黄素激发试验作为功能性生物标志物的诊断效能，以及SLC52A3 c.670T > C变异的功能学验证结果。

items.abstractZh: Brown-Vialetto-Van Laere综合征（BVVLS）是一种罕见的、可治疗的神经退行性疾病，由核黄素转运体基因变异（SLC52A2、SLC52A3）引起。其早期症状可模仿神经肌肉接头疾病，导致诊断延迟。一名来自近亲婚配家庭的3.5岁女童在2.5岁时表现为孤立性双侧上睑下垂，随后出现吞咽困难、发声困难、双侧面瘫、喘鸣和呼吸功能受损。检查发现舌萎缩伴肌束颤动及延髓肌无力，但肢体肌力正常。被诊断为血清阴性重症肌无力，对皮质类固醇、吡啶斯的明、沙丁胺醇和静脉注射免疫球蛋白均无反应。缺乏疲劳性、存在下运动神经元体征以及同胞有听力丧失和延髓麻痹病史，促使进行基因检测，发现SLC52A3纯合错义变异（c.670T > C；p.Phe224Leu）。大剂量核黄素（最高50 mg/kg/天）使延髓功能逐渐改善，喘鸣消失，呼吸稳定，但上睑下垂和舌肌束颤动持续存在。本报告的新颖之处在于，对一名携带意义未明变异的患者，将核黄素临床反应用作核黄素转运体缺乏症（RTD）的功能性生物标志物，这与既往具有明确遗传学证据的病例不同。当遗传结果不明确时，经验性核黄素激发试验提供了一个实用框架。对于治疗抵抗、非波动性上睑下垂和延髓肌无力的儿童，尤其是有近亲婚配或听力丧失和延髓麻痹家族史者，应怀疑RTD。早期大剂量核黄素可防止病情恶化，而免疫抑制无效且可能有害。
items.frontierRationale: 该新近病例报告提出以核黄素临床反应作为功能性生物标志物，用于在遗传变异意义未明时诊断可治疗的核黄素转运体缺乏症，对ALS领域中可治疗性运动神经元病模仿者的早期识别具有转化价值。

items.title: Restoring Neural Homeostasis via Class II HDAC Modulation: Mechanistic Insights and Therapeutic Opportunities.
items.summary: Class II histone deacetylases (HDACs) comprise class IIa enzymes HDAC4, HDAC5, HDAC7, and HDAC9 and class IIb enzymes HDAC6 and HDAC10, which differ substantially in structure, catalytic activity, subcellular localization, and neural function. Class IIa HDACs exhibit weak intrinsic deacetylase activity and function predominantly as signal-responsive scaffolds that couple calcium and kinase signaling to transcription through nucleocytoplasmic shuttling, recruitment of HDAC3-containing NCoR/SMRT corepressor complexes, and interactions with MEF2, CREB, and FOXO. Conversely, HDAC6 is a predominantly cytoplasmic deacetylase that regulates α-tubulin acetylation, cytoskeletal dynamics, axonal transport, autophagy, and proteostasis. Dysregulated class II HDAC signaling contributes to neurodegenerative diseases through convergent mechanisms involving synaptic dysfunction, maladaptive transcriptional repression, mitochondrial impairment, oxidative stress, neuroinflammation, blood-brain barrier disruption, and defective clearance of pathological proteins. Disease-associated substrates include amyloid-β and tau in Alzheimer's disease, α-synuclein in Parkinson's disease, mutant huntingtin in Huntington's disease, and TDP-43/SOD1 in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Emerging evidence additionally links aberrant HDAC4/5 signaling to neurodevelopmental disorders through altered synaptic maturation, excitation-inhibition balance, and circuit development. This review integrates the structural and mechanistic biology of class II HDACs with their disease-specific roles and evaluates therapeutic approaches to restore neural homeostasis. Particular emphasis is placed on selective HDAC6 inhibitors, modulation of class IIa protein-protein interactions and subcellular trafficking, natural compounds, and RNA-based strategies. Finally, we discuss major translational challenges, including isoform specificity, brain penetration, context-dependent functions, and the need to distinguish catalytic from non-enzymic mechanisms when developing disease-modifying interventions for neurological disorders while preserving normal essential HDAC functions and minimizing off-target toxicity.
items.titleZh: 通过II类HDAC调控恢复神经稳态：机制见解与治疗机遇
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述系统梳理了II类HDAC（包括IIa类的HDAC4/5/7/9和IIb类的HDAC6/10）在神经退行性疾病中的机制与治疗潜力。IIa类HDAC主要作为信号支架调控转录，而HDAC6则调控微管乙酰化、轴突运输和自噬。在ALS中，TDP-43和SOD1被列为疾病相关底物，提示II类HDAC信号失调可能通过蛋白质稳态、神经炎症和线粒体损伤等通路参与ALS病理。文章重点评估了选择性HDAC6抑制剂、靶向IIa类蛋白相互作用、天然化合物和RNA策略等治疗方向，并指出亚型特异性、脑渗透性和催化与非酶机制区分是转化关键挑战。
items.insight: 该综述将II类HDAC的机制生物学与ALS中TDP-43/SOD1相关病理直接关联，为ALS研究者提供了从表观遗传调控角度理解蛋白质稳态和神经炎症的新框架。尤其值得关注的是，文章强调区分HDAC的催化活性与非酶支架功能，这对开发避免脱靶毒性的疾病修饰疗法具有直接指导意义。选择性HDAC6抑制剂和靶向IIa类蛋白相互作用策略可能成为ALS治疗的新切入点。

aiRead.keyFinding: II类HDAC（尤其是HDAC4/5/6）通过调控转录、微管乙酰化、自噬和蛋白质稳态参与ALS等神经退行性疾病，靶向这些酶的选择性抑制剂或蛋白相互作用调节剂具有治疗潜力。
aiRead.limitation: 作为综述，未提供原始实验数据；所讨论的治疗策略多处于临床前阶段，缺乏临床疗效验证；亚型特异性、脑渗透性和脱靶毒性等转化挑战尚未解决。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注选择性HDAC6抑制剂和IIa类HDAC蛋白相互作用调节剂在ALS模型中的后续临床前及早期临床试验结果，以及区分催化与非酶机制的工具化合物开发进展。

items.abstractZh: II类组蛋白去乙酰化酶（HDACs）包括IIa类酶HDAC4、HDAC5、HDAC7和HDAC9，以及IIb类酶HDAC6和HDAC10，它们在结构、催化活性、亚细胞定位和神经功能方面存在显著差异。IIa类HDACs的内在去乙酰化酶活性较弱，主要作为信号响应性支架蛋白，通过核质穿梭、招募含HDAC3的NCoR/SMRT辅阻遏物复合物以及与MEF2、CREB和FOXO的相互作用，将钙和激酶信号与转录偶联。相反，HDAC6是一种主要位于细胞质的去乙酰化酶，调节α-微管蛋白乙酰化、细胞骨架动力学、轴突运输、自噬和蛋白质稳态。II类HDAC信号失调通过涉及突触功能障碍、适应不良性转录抑制、线粒体损伤、氧化应激、神经炎症、血脑屏障破坏和病理蛋白清除缺陷的汇聚机制，促进神经退行性疾病。疾病相关底物包括阿尔茨海默病中的淀粉样蛋白-β和tau、帕金森病中的α-突触核蛋白、亨廷顿病中的突变亨廷顿蛋白，以及肌萎缩侧索硬化中的TDP-43/SOD1。新出现的证据还通过突触成熟、兴奋-抑制平衡和回路发育的改变，将异常的HDAC4/5信号与神经发育障碍联系起来。本综述整合了II类HDACs的结构和机制生物学及其疾病特异性作用，并评估了恢复神经稳态的治疗方法。特别强调了选择性HDAC6抑制剂、IIa类蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用和亚细胞运输的调节、天然化合物以及基于RNA的策略。最后，我们讨论了主要的转化挑战，包括亚型特异性、脑渗透性、情境依赖性功能，以及在开发神经系统疾病疾病修饰干预措施时区分催化机制与非酶机制的必要性，同时保留正常的必需HDAC功能并最小化脱靶毒性。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近整合了II类HDAC在ALS等神经退行性疾病中的机制与治疗策略，强调亚型选择性调控和催化与非酶机制区分，具有明确的转化价值。

items.title: Bullous Pemphigoid in Patients with Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis: A Retrospective Study of 1,067 Cases.
items.summary: Background Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder that affects motor neurons. Bullous pemphigoid (BP) is an autoimmune blistering disease associated with autoantibodies against BP180 and BP230. Previous studies have suggested an increased incidence of BP in patients with ALS. However, the neurological status and disease severity of patients with ALS at the time of BP onset remain insufficiently characterized. This study aimed to investigate the frequency and clinical characteristics of BP in patients with ALS.Methods In this retrospective study, we reviewed the medical records of 1,067 patients with ALS who were admitted to our institution between April 2010 and May 2025. Patients who developed BP after the onset of ALS were identified. BP was diagnosed by dermatologists based on clinical findings and, when available, by immunological or histopathological examinations. Disease severity at BP onset was assessed based on the ambulatory status and ventilatory support requirements.Results Seven of the 1,067 patients (0.66%) developed BP after ALS onset. The median interval between ALS and BP onset was 8.0 years (IQR 5.0-16.5). At BP onset, four patients (57.1%) were bedridden, four (57.1%) required tracheostomy and invasive ventilation, and two (28.6%) required non-invasive ventilation. Five patients (71.4%) required enteral feeding. The median age at BP onset was 68.0 years (IQR, 64.0-72.5). BP180 antibody testing was positive in three of the six patients. The lesions most commonly involved both the extremities and the trunk.Conclusion BP may occur more frequently in ALS patients than in the general population. Clinicians should consider BP when evaluating cutaneous lesions in patients with ALS.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化患者中的大疱性类天疱疮：一项1067例病例的回顾性研究
items.summaryZh: 这项回顾性研究分析了1067例ALS患者，发现7例（0.66%）在ALS发病后出现大疱性类天疱疮（BP），中位间隔8年。BP发病时多数患者已处于疾病晚期，表现为卧床、需要通气支持或肠内营养。研究提示ALS患者中BP可能比一般人群更常见，临床医生应警惕ALS患者的皮肤病变。
items.insight: 该研究提示ALS患者中自身免疫性大疱性皮肤病BP的发生率可能升高，且多出现在ALS病程晚期、功能状态严重受损时。这为ALS的神经炎症与自身免疫交叉机制提供了临床线索，也提醒ALS研究者关注皮肤作为免疫异常观察窗口的价值，并可能影响晚期ALS患者的综合管理。

aiRead.studyType: 单中心回顾性观察性研究
aiRead.keyFinding: 1067例ALS患者中7例（0.66%）发生大疱性类天疱疮，中位间隔8年，多数发生在疾病晚期且功能严重受损时。
aiRead.limitation: 回顾性单中心设计，样本量小（仅7例BP），缺乏一般人群对照，无法确定因果关系或确切发病率。
aiRead.watchNext: 需要多中心前瞻性研究验证ALS患者中BP的真实发病率，并探索ALS相关免疫异常与BP发病的潜在共同机制。

items.abstractZh: 背景：肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种影响运动神经元的进行性神经退行性疾病。大疱性类天疱疮（BP）是一种自身免疫性大疱性疾病，与针对BP180和BP230的自身抗体相关。既往研究提示ALS患者中BP的发病率升高。然而，ALS患者发生BP时的神经功能状态和疾病严重程度尚未得到充分描述。本研究旨在探讨ALS患者中BP的发生频率及临床特征。方法：在这项回顾性研究中，我们回顾了2010年4月至2025年5月期间入住本机构的1067例ALS患者的病历。识别出在ALS发病后发生BP的患者。BP由皮肤科医生根据临床表现诊断，并在可获得时结合免疫学或组织病理学检查。BP发病时的疾病严重程度根据行走状态和通气支持需求进行评估。结果：1067例患者中有7例（0.66%）在ALS发病后发生BP。ALS发病与BP发病之间的中位间隔为8.0年（IQR 5.0-16.5）。BP发病时，4例患者（57.1%）卧床，4例（57.1%）需要气管切开及有创通气，2例（28.6%）需要无创通气。5例患者（71.4%）需要肠内营养。BP发病时的中位年龄为68.0岁（IQR 64.0-72.5）。6例患者中有3例BP180抗体检测阳性。皮损最常同时累及四肢和躯干。结论：BP在ALS患者中的发生频率可能高于一般人群。临床医生在评估ALS患者的皮肤病变时应考虑BP。
items.frontierRationale: 基于1067例ALS队列的最新回顾性数据，提示ALS患者中自身免疫性大疱性类天疱疮的发生频率可能高于一般人群，具有神经免疫交叉机制探索价值。

items.title: TBK1 overexpression reduces neuronal loss in the P497S UBQLN2 mouse model of ALS/FTD.
items.summary: Missense mutations in UBQLN2 are linked to dominant inheritance of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) which is frequently accompanied by frontotemporal dementia (FTD). The encoded UBQLN2 protein functions to maintain proteostasis, collapse of which is increasingly being realized as the cause of many neurodegenerative diseases. During investigations of our UBQLN2 mouse models of ALS/FTD, we observed a significant decline in Tank-binding kinase 1 (TBK1) protein in end-stage mice. The decline could be significant, as haploinsufficiency of TBK1 expression is linked to ALS/FTD. To determine whether the reduction in TBK1 levels is responsible for driving pathogenesis, we crossed P497S UBQLN2 transgenic (Tg) mice with BacTBK1 Tg mice that overexpress TBK1 and analyzed the progeny for signs of pathology. The analysis revealed that double transgenic mice had a significant reduction in neurodegeneration in both the brain and spinal cord (SC) compared to P497S single-Tg mice. Double immunofluorescence staining of P497S mouse tissue revealed TBK1 colocalizes with UBQLN2 aggregates in spinal motor neurons. Biochemical extraction studies of mouse brain tissue revealed increased enrichment of TBK1 along with wild type and mutant UBQLN2 proteins in detergent-insoluble material, suggesting TBK1 gets sequestered by UBQLN2 aggregates. GST-pulldown assays revealed that UBQLN2 binds directly with TBK1, but paradoxically the P497S mutation was found to reduce TBK1 binding. Turnover studies indicated that loss of UBQLN2 destabilizes TBK1, providing another route for its reduction. These findings lead us to propose that efforts directed toward increasing TBK1 expression may provide a therapeutic approach for treating ALS/FTD caused by UBQLN2 mutations.
items.titleZh: TBK1过表达可减少ALS/FTD的P497S UBQLN2小鼠模型中的神经元丢失
items.summaryZh: 该研究在小鼠模型中探索了TBK1水平下降在UBQLN2突变所致ALS/FTD中的作用。研究者发现，在P497S UBQLN2转基因小鼠终末期，TBK1蛋白显著减少；通过将这类小鼠与过表达TBK1的小鼠杂交，双转基因后代的脑和脊髓神经退行性变明显减轻。机制上，TBK1与UBQLN2聚集体共定位并被隔离于去垢剂不溶性组分，UBQLN2可直接结合TBK1，而P497S突变降低该结合；UBQLN2缺失还会使TBK1不稳定。作者据此提出，提高TBK1表达可能成为针对UBQLN2突变相关ALS/FTD的潜在治疗策略。
items.insight: 这项研究将UBQLN2突变、TBK1单倍剂量不足和蛋白稳态崩溃联系到同一病理轴，并在体内小鼠模型中提供了TBK1过表达减轻神经退行性变的遗传学证据。对ALS研究者而言，它提示TBK1水平下降可能是UBQLN2相关ALS/FTD的可干预节点，也为理解TBK1在ALS中的双重角色（单倍剂量不足致病与过表达保护）提供了新的机制线索。

aiRead.studyType: 动物模型与细胞机制研究
aiRead.keyFinding: 在P497S UBQLN2小鼠中，TBK1过表达显著减少脑和脊髓的神经退行性变；UBQLN2聚集体隔离TBK1，且UBQLN2缺失使TBK1不稳定。
aiRead.limitation: 证据来自小鼠模型和体外实验，尚不能确定在人类ALS/FTD患者中增加TBK1表达是否安全有效。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续需关注TBK1过表达或激活策略在更多ALS/FTD模型中的验证、剂量与安全性评估，以及是否推进至临床前开发。

items.abstractZh: UBQLN2的错义突变与肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的显性遗传相关，且常伴随额颞叶痴呆（FTD）。所编码的UBQLN2蛋白功能在于维持蛋白稳态，而蛋白稳态的崩溃正日益被认为是许多神经退行性疾病的病因。在我们对ALS/FTD的UBQLN2小鼠模型进行研究期间，我们观察到终末期小鼠中Tank结合激酶1（TBK1）蛋白显著下降。这一下降可能具有重要意义，因为TBK1表达的单倍剂量不足与ALS/FTD相关。为确定TBK1水平的降低是否驱动了发病机制，我们将P497S UBQLN2转基因（Tg）小鼠与过表达TBK1的BacTBK1 Tg小鼠杂交，并分析子代是否存在病理迹象。分析显示，与P497S单转基因小鼠相比，双转基因小鼠在脑和脊髓（SC）中的神经退行性变均显著减少。对P497S小鼠组织的双重免疫荧光染色显示，TBK1与脊髓运动神经元中的UBQLN2聚集体共定位。对小鼠脑组织的生化提取研究显示，TBK1与野生型和突变型UBQLN2蛋白在去垢剂不溶性物质中富集增加，提示TBK1被UBQLN2聚集体隔离。GST下拉实验显示UBQLN2与TBK1直接结合，但矛盾的是，P497S突变被发现会降低TBK1结合。周转研究表明，UBQLN2的缺失会使TBK1不稳定，为其减少提供了另一条途径。这些发现使我们提出，旨在增加TBK1表达的努力可能为治疗由UBQLN2突变引起的ALS/FTD提供一种治疗途径。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年发表，在UBQLN2突变相关ALS/FTD小鼠模型中证明过表达TBK1可减轻神经退行性变，为TBK1靶向治疗提供了新的临床前转化依据。

items.title: Cellular senescence is an early feature and therapeutic target in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis TDP-43 Q331K mice.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder characterized by progressive motor neuron degeneration in the motor cortex and spinal cord. Aging is a key risk factor for ALS, and cellular senescence - a hallmark of aging marked by irreversible cell-cycle arrest and a pro-inflammatory senescence-associated secretory phenotype - has been implicated in neurodegeneration, yet its role in ALS progression remains incompletely understood. Here, we show that molecular markers of cellular senescence emerge in the motor cortex and spinal cord alongside declines in neural and neuromuscular function in TDP-43 Q331K ALS mice, supporting senescence as an early feature of ALS pathology. To test whether reduced senescence ameliorates ALS pathology, we evaluated longitudinal senolytic treatment with dasatinib and quercetin (D&Q) in TDP-43 Q331K mice. D&Q treatment improved motor behavior, neuromuscular function, and reduced axonal damage as measured by plasma neurofilament light chain, accompanied by robust improvements in motor cortex excitability and preservation of layer V neuron counts. At the cellular level, cortical microglia were implicated as a potential mediator of senolytic benefits based on reduced microglial TDP-43 burden and senescence markers. Together, these findings identify cellular senescence as an early, disease-relevant, and modifiable feature of ALS pathology.
items.titleZh: 细胞衰老是肌萎缩侧索硬化TDP-43 Q331K小鼠的早期特征及治疗靶点
items.summaryZh: 该研究在TDP-43 Q331K ALS小鼠模型中发现，细胞衰老标志物在运动皮层和脊髓中早期出现，并与神经及神经肌肉功能下降同步。使用达沙替尼联合槲皮素进行衰老细胞清除治疗，可改善运动行为、神经肌肉功能和运动皮层兴奋性，减少轴突损伤，并保留皮层V层神经元。皮层小胶质细胞可能是介导这些获益的关键细胞。研究提示细胞衰老是ALS早期、可干预的病理特征。
items.insight: 这项研究将细胞衰老定位为ALS的早期可修饰特征，并提供了衰老细胞清除药物在遗传性ALS小鼠模型中的纵向干预证据。其价值在于：第一，衰老标志物与功能下降同步出现，提示衰老可能是驱动疾病进展的早期机制而非终末现象；第二，D&Q治疗在运动行为、神经肌肉功能、血浆NfL和皮层兴奋性等多个层面显示获益，为衰老细胞清除策略的临床转化提供了临床前依据；第三，小胶质细胞被识别为潜在介导细胞，连接了神经炎症与衰老机制。对ALS研究者而言，该研究提示应关注衰老细胞清除药物在ALS临床试验中的潜力，并进一步验证小胶质细胞靶向衰老通路的作用。

aiRead.studyType: 动物模型研究（TDP-43 Q331K ALS小鼠）
aiRead.keyFinding: 细胞衰老标志物在ALS小鼠运动皮层和脊髓中早期出现，达沙替尼联合槲皮素衰老细胞清除治疗可改善运动行为、神经肌肉功能、运动皮层兴奋性并减少轴突损伤，皮层小胶质细胞可能是介导获益的关键细胞。
aiRead.limitation: 研究基于TDP-43 Q331K小鼠模型，尚不能直接推断人类ALS患者的疗效；衰老细胞清除治疗的最佳剂量、时间窗和长期安全性未在摘要中说明；小胶质细胞作为介导者的因果性证据仍需进一步验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续应关注该衰老细胞清除策略在其它ALS模型中的可重复性、小胶质细胞特异性衰老通路的机制研究，以及达沙替尼联合槲皮素或其它衰老细胞清除药物在ALS临床试验中的早期安全性和生物标志物评估。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，以运动皮层和脊髓中运动神经元的进行性退变为特征。衰老是ALS的关键危险因素，而细胞衰老——一种以不可逆细胞周期停滞和促炎性衰老相关分泌表型为标志的衰老特征——已被认为与神经退行性变有关，但其在ALS进展中的作用仍不完全清楚。在此，我们显示，在TDP-43 Q331K ALS小鼠中，细胞衰老的分子标志物与神经及神经肌肉功能下降同时出现在运动皮层和脊髓中，支持衰老是ALS病理的早期特征。为检验减少衰老是否能改善ALS病理，我们在TDP-43 Q331K小鼠中评估了达沙替尼和槲皮素（D&Q）的纵向衰老细胞清除治疗。D&Q治疗改善了运动行为、神经肌肉功能，并减少了通过血浆神经丝轻链测得的轴突损伤，同时伴有运动皮层兴奋性的显著改善和V层神经元计数的保留。在细胞水平上，基于小胶质细胞TDP-43负荷和衰老标志物的减少，皮层小胶质细胞被认为是衰老细胞清除获益的潜在介导者。总之，这些发现将细胞衰老确定为ALS病理的一个早期、疾病相关且可修饰的特征。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年发表，首次在TDP-43 Q331K ALS小鼠中证明细胞衰老是早期可修饰特征，并显示衰老细胞清除治疗可改善功能结局，具有明确的ALS相关性和转化价值。

items.title: Selective neuroprotection in the ALS-FTD spectrum: Mechanisms of neuronal resilience and translational perspectives.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is increasingly recognized as part of a broader clinico-pathological continuum encompassing frontotemporal dementia (FTD). Despite progressive degeneration across motor and cognitive neural systems associated with TDP-43 pathology, specific neuronal populations-including the oculomotor and abducens nuclei, Onuf's nucleus, and sensory dorsal column pathways-remain relatively preserved. Selectively preserved neuronal structures in ALS have largely been described as isolated neuropathological observations without sufficient mechanistic integration. This review aims to synthesize candidate intrinsic and microenvironmental mechanisms that may contribute to selective neuronal preservation and propose a translational framework for understanding neuronal resilience in the ALS-FTD spectrum. We conducted a comprehensive critical review of the literature addressing selective neuronal vulnerability and resistance in ALS-FTD, integrating comparative observations from related neurodegenerative and neuromuscular disorders. Particular emphasis was placed on candidate mechanisms associated with neuronal resilience, including Nrf2/ARE signaling, calcium homeostasis, glutamatergic receptor composition, glial-mediated neurotrophic support, and emerging transcriptomic evidence relevant to selective neuronal vulnerability. Selective preservation of specific neuronal populations represents a distinctive biological characteristic of the ALS-FTD spectrum. Current evidence suggests that enhanced antioxidant defense, tightly regulated intracellular calcium dynamics, protective microenvironmental interactions, and other stress-response pathways may collectively contribute to resistance against TDP-43 proteinopathy. These findings may provide a mechanistic framework for understanding selective neuronal resilience and suggest potential avenues for future neuroprotective therapeutic development. Integrating mechanisms of selective neuroprotection with translational neurobiological perspectives may provide a conceptual framework for ALS research. Leveraging preserved neural systems may not only inform biologically grounded supportive care strategies but also help identify mechanistically relevant targets for future disease-modifying interventions.
items.titleZh: ALS-FTD谱系中的选择性神经保护：神经元韧性机制与转化前景
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理了ALS-FTD谱系中为何某些神经元（如动眼神经核、Onuf核、感觉背柱通路）相对耐受TDP-43病理，而运动神经元却进行性退化。文章整合了Nrf2/ARE抗氧化通路、钙稳态、谷氨酸受体组成、胶质细胞营养支持及转录组学等候选机制，提出选择性神经元韧性可能是多因素共同作用的结果，并探讨了利用这些内源性保护机制开发神经保护疗法的转化思路。
items.insight: 该综述将ALS中长期以来被当作孤立病理现象的选择性神经元保留，提升为一个可机制化研究的韧性模型。对ALS研究者而言，其价值在于：第一，它提示疾病修饰干预的靶点可能不仅在于清除TDP-43毒性，还在于增强内源性保护通路；第二，它整合了Nrf2/ARE、钙调控、胶质支持等多个可干预节点，为临床前研究提供了候选方向；第三，它强调比较神经生物学视角，即通过理解为何某些神经元不生病，来反推运动神经元为何生病。

aiRead.keyFinding: ALS-FTD中特定神经元群体的选择性保留可能由Nrf2/ARE抗氧化信号、钙稳态调控、谷氨酸受体组成、胶质营养支持及转录组特征等多机制共同介导，构成一个可转化的神经元韧性框架。
aiRead.limitation: 作为综述，文章未提供原始实验数据，所提出的机制框架仍需功能验证；选择性神经元保留的因果机制尚未明确。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续研究是否针对Nrf2/ARE通路、钙调控或胶质支持等候选机制开展ALS模型的功能验证和临床前干预测试。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）日益被认为是一个更广泛的临床-病理连续谱的一部分，该连续谱涵盖额颞叶痴呆（FTD）。尽管与TDP-43病理相关的运动与认知神经系统出现进行性退化，特定神经元群体——包括动眼神经核和展神经核、Onuf核以及感觉背柱通路——仍相对保留。ALS中选择性保留的神经元结构在很大程度上被描述为孤立的神经病理学观察，缺乏充分的机制整合。本综述旨在综合可能促成选择性神经元保留的候选内在与微环境机制，并提出一个理解ALS-FTD谱系中神经元韧性的转化框架。我们对涉及ALS-FTD中选择性神经元易感性与抵抗性的文献进行了全面的批判性综述，整合了来自相关神经退行性疾病和神经肌肉疾病的比较观察。特别关注与神经元韧性相关的候选机制，包括Nrf2/ARE信号通路、钙稳态、谷氨酸能受体组成、胶质细胞介导的神经营养支持，以及与选择性神经元易感性相关的新兴转录组学证据。特定神经元群体的选择性保留是ALS-FTD谱系的一个独特生物学特征。当前证据提示，增强的抗氧化防御、严格调控的细胞内钙动态、保护性微环境相互作用以及其他应激反应通路可能共同促成对TDP-43蛋白病的抵抗。这些发现可能为理解选择性神经元韧性提供机制框架，并为未来神经保护治疗开发提示潜在途径。将选择性神经保护机制与转化神经生物学视角相整合，可能为ALS研究提供一个概念框架。利用保留的神经系统不仅可能为有生物学依据的支持性照护策略提供信息，还可能有助于识别未来疾病修饰干预的机制相关靶点。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述于2026年发表，聚焦ALS-FTD谱系中选择性神经元韧性的多机制整合，为神经保护靶点发现提供了新的转化框架。

items.title: Motor coordination and behavioural deficits in a mouse model of KMT2B-related dystonia.
items.summary: Pathogenic variants in KMT2B cause early-onset dystonia, but a mouse model that has undergone comprehensive, dystonia-oriented phenotyping is lacking. We conducted detailed phenotyping on heterozygous Kmt2b constitutive knockout mice and wild-type littermates, assessing growth, neurobehavioural traits, motor coordination, sensorimotor gating, social behaviour and metabolic parameters, combined with striatal RNA sequencing. Kmt2b knockout mice of both sexes were viable but significantly smaller and lighter than littermate controls. Knockouts were hyperlocomotive in the open field and showed approximately two-fold larger acoustic startle responses; unexpectedly, prepulse inhibition was enhanced rather than reduced at all prepulse intensities. On the balance beam, knockouts crossed more slowly and paused more frequently; female knockouts also paused more on the ladder rung task. Frame-by-frame video analysis revealed a claw-like hindpaw posture characterized by abnormal inward flexion of the digits. Knockout mice spent less time investigating a novel conspecific, while social recognition memory remained intact. Striatal RNA sequencing confirmed reduction of Kmt2b transcript to approximately half of control levels and identified 177 differentially expressed genes, including Maob, encoding monoamine oxidase B; gene set enrichment analysis implicated neurodevelopmental, glial and mitochondrial processes. Nociception, vision, body-weight-adjusted grip strength, and clinical chemistry and haematological measures were largely unaffected. Heterozygous Kmt2b knockout mice show hyperlocomotion, altered sensorimotor gating, impaired motor coordination with dystonic-like paw posturing and reduced sociability, alongside a striatal transcriptomic signature implicating neurodevelopmental processes. The model mirrors aspects of human KMT2B-related dystonia and provides a platform for mechanistic study; environmental or pharmacological challenge may be needed to unmask overt dystonic features.
items.titleZh: KMT2B相关肌张力障碍小鼠模型中的运动协调与行为缺陷
items.summaryZh: 该研究对杂合Kmt2b敲除小鼠进行了全面表型分析，发现其存在活动过度、惊跳反应增强、前脉冲抑制反常增强、运动协调障碍、肌张力障碍样后爪姿势及社交性降低，纹状体转录组显示Kmt2b表达减半并涉及神经发育、胶质和线粒体相关基因改变。该模型部分再现了人类KMT2B相关肌张力障碍特征，但未出现明显自发性肌张力障碍，提示可能需要额外挑战才能完全显现表型。
items.insight: KMT2B相关肌张力障碍与ALS同属神经退行性运动障碍，该模型为研究纹状体神经发育、线粒体功能和单胺代谢在运动控制障碍中的作用提供了新工具。其纹状体转录组中Maob等基因的改变及线粒体过程富集，可能与ALS中的氧化应激和线粒体功能障碍机制存在交叉，值得关注其是否可用于跨疾病机制比较或治疗靶点验证。

items.abstractZh: KMT2B的致病性变异可导致早发性肌张力障碍，但目前尚缺乏经过全面、以肌张力障碍为导向的表型分析的小鼠模型。我们对杂合Kmt2b组成型敲除小鼠及其野生型同窝对照进行了详细表型分析，评估了生长、神经行为特征、运动协调、感觉运动门控、社会行为和代谢参数，并结合纹状体RNA测序。两种性别的Kmt2b敲除小鼠均可存活，但体型和体重显著小于同窝对照。敲除小鼠在旷场中表现出活动过度，听觉惊跳反应约增大两倍；出乎意料的是，在所有前脉冲强度下，前脉冲抑制均增强而非减弱。在平衡木上，敲除小鼠通过速度更慢、停顿更频繁；雌性敲除小鼠在梯级任务中的停顿也更多。逐帧视频分析揭示了一种爪样后爪姿势，其特征为趾部异常向内弯曲。敲除小鼠探索新异同种个体的时间减少，而社会识别记忆保持完整。纹状体RNA测序证实Kmt2b转录本降至对照水平约一半，并鉴定出177个差异表达基因，包括编码单胺氧化酶B的Maob；基因集富集分析提示神经发育、胶质和线粒体过程参与其中。痛觉、视觉、体重校正后的握力以及临床化学和血液学指标基本未受影响。杂合Kmt2b敲除小鼠表现出活动过度、感觉运动门控改变、运动协调受损伴肌张力障碍样爪姿势以及社交性降低，同时伴有提示神经发育过程的纹状体转录组特征。该模型反映了人类KMT2B相关肌张力障碍的某些方面，为机制研究提供了平台；可能需要环境或药物挑战才能揭示明显的肌张力障碍特征。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年新近发表，首次对KMT2B相关肌张力障碍小鼠模型进行系统行为与纹状体转录组分析，为理解该病及与ALS共享的神经发育和线粒体机制提供了转化研究平台。

items.title: Astrocyte-derived extracellular vesicle phosphorylated TDP-43 as a blood-based biomarker for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disease characterized by central nervous system (CNS) neuroglial TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) pathology in ∼90-95% of cases. Non-invasive biomarkers are critically needed to reduce diagnostic delay, enable patient stratification, and assess treatment efficacy in clinical trials. Astrocyte-derived extracellular vesicles (ADEVs) represent promising CNS liquid biopsy biomarkers, given astrocyte involvement in ALS pathogenesis and the ability of ADEVs to cross the blood-brain barrier and carry TDP-43. Here, we assessed the diagnostic performance of TDP-43 and its hyperphosphorylated pathological form, phospho-Ser409 (pTDP-43), quantified in ADEVs, for distinguishing ALS cases from matched healthy controls. ADEVs were immunoisolated from whole blood (n = 76) and plasma (n = 86) across three ALS biorepositories/cohorts. ADEV quality and enrichment were validated in accordance with minimal information for studies of extracellular vesicles guidelines, and protein levels were normalized by ratio to tetraspanin cluster of differentiation 81 (CD81). Diagnostic accuracy was evaluated by logistic regression and random forest models with cross-validation, adjusting for age and sex across 100 random seeds. Plasma ADEV pTDP-43/CD81 ratio best predicted ALS case status, with a mean AUC of 0.89 (95% CI: 0.75-0.99) from logistic models, corresponding to a mean sensitivity and specificity of 87% and 89%, respectively, and a mean AUC of 0.86 (95% CI: 0.82-0.90) from random forest models. Although the specificity of ADEV pTDP-43 relative to disease mimics and associations with disease progression require further investigation, these findings support its potential as a biomarker candidate for ALS and for patient stratification in TDP-43-targeted clinical trials.
items.titleZh: 星形胶质细胞来源的细胞外囊泡磷酸化TDP-43作为肌萎缩侧索硬化症的血源性生物标志物
items.summaryZh: 该研究从全血和血浆中免疫分离星形胶质细胞来源的细胞外囊泡，检测其中TDP-43及其磷酸化形式pTDP-43的水平，发现血浆ADEV pTDP-43/CD81比值在区分ALS患者与健康对照方面具有较高的诊断准确性（逻辑回归平均AUC 0.89，随机森林平均AUC 0.86）。研究提示该指标有望作为ALS的血源性生物标志物，并可能用于TDP-43靶向临床试验的患者分层，但其对疾病模拟者的特异性及与疾病进展的关联尚待验证。
items.insight: 该研究提供了一种基于星形胶质细胞来源细胞外囊泡的血源性TDP-43病理检测方法，直接回应了ALS领域对非侵入性、可反映中枢神经系统病理的生物标志物的迫切需求。其诊断性能在多个独立队列中经过交叉验证，且与TDP-43靶向治疗试验的患者分层需求高度契合，值得ALS研究者关注其后续在疾病模拟者鉴别、纵向进展监测及治疗反应评估中的验证结果。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，约90-95%的病例以中枢神经系统（CNS）神经胶质细胞TAR DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）病理为特征。目前迫切需要非侵入性生物标志物以减少诊断延迟、实现患者分层并评估临床试验中的治疗效果。鉴于星形胶质细胞参与ALS发病机制，且星形胶质细胞来源的细胞外囊泡（ADEVs）能够穿越血脑屏障并携带TDP-43，ADEVs代表了一种有前景的中枢神经系统液体活检生物标志物。本研究评估了在ADEVs中定量的TDP-43及其过度磷酸化病理形式——磷酸化Ser409（pTDP-43）——在区分ALS病例与匹配健康对照中的诊断性能。ADEVs从三个ALS生物样本库/队列的全血（n=76）和血浆（n=86）中免疫分离。ADEV质量和富集度按照细胞外囊泡研究最低信息指南进行验证，蛋白水平通过与外泌体标志物分化簇81（CD81）的比值进行归一化。诊断准确性通过逻辑回归和随机森林模型结合交叉验证进行评估，并在100个随机种子中调整年龄和性别。血浆ADEV pTDP-43/CD81比值最能预测ALS病例状态，逻辑回归模型的平均AUC为0.89（95% CI：0.75-0.99），对应平均敏感性和特异性分别为87%和89%，随机森林模型的平均AUC为0.86（95% CI：0.82-0.90）。尽管ADEV pTDP-43相对于疾病模拟者的特异性以及与疾病进展的关联仍需进一步研究，但这些发现支持其作为ALS生物标志物候选物以及用于TDP-43靶向临床试验中患者分层的潜力。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近报道了星形胶质细胞来源细胞外囊泡中磷酸化TDP-43作为ALS血源性生物标志物的诊断性能，具有直接支持TDP-43靶向临床试验患者分层的转化价值。

items.title: Associations of cumulative exposure and longitudinal trajectories of neurofilament light chain with 1-year adverse events in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: A prospective cohort study.
items.summary: Baseline neurofilament light chain (NFL) predicts amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) outcomes, but it does not summarize early repeated biomarker information. We evaluated whether cumulative NFL exposure (cuNFL), calculated over an early monitoring window, and longitudinal NFL trajectory groups were associated with subsequent adverse events in a prospective cohort. This prospective study enrolled patients with ALS from 32 provinces in China between January 2024 and January 2025. Plasma NFL was measured at baseline, month 1, and month 2. We used K-means clustering to describe longitudinal NFL patterns and multivariable survival models to evaluate prognostic associations. Inverse-probability weighting and causal-forest analyses were used as exploratory, confounding-adjusted analyses of high versus low cuNFL. K-means clustering identified three longitudinal NFL groups: Low-Stable (n = 183), Moderate (n = 225), and High-Progressive (n = 100). The High-Progressive group had the shortest event-free survival (P < 0.001). Each 1-SD increment in cuNFL was associated with higher odds of adverse events (adjusted OR 1.99; 95% CI 1.52-2.60; P < 0.001). Using the manuscript-defined 127-event outcome, apparent discrimination was AUC 0.730 for cuNFL and 0.717 for baseline NFL. The paired DeLong comparison was not statistically significant (P = 0.084). Exploratory machine-learning analyses suggested heterogeneity in the association of high cuNFL with outcome by age and respiratory function. Early repeated NFL measurements summarized as cuNFL and longitudinal trajectory groups were associated with short-term adverse events in this cohort. These findings support further external validation of longitudinal NFL-based risk stratification. They do not establish a causal biological effect or a basis for routine repeated measurement.
items.titleZh: 累积暴露与神经丝轻链纵向轨迹与肌萎缩侧索硬化1年不良事件的关联：一项前瞻性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 这项在中国32个省份开展的前瞻性队列研究，对508例ALS患者在基线、第1个月和第2个月重复检测血浆NFL，并计算累积NFL暴露（cuNFL）及纵向轨迹分组。结果显示，高-进展轨迹组无事件生存期最短；cuNFL每升高1个标准差，1年内不良事件风险约增加一倍（校正OR 1.99）。cuNFL的预测区分度（AUC 0.730）略高于基线NFL（0.717），但差异未达统计学显著。研究为观察性设计，不能证明因果，也不支持将重复NFL检测常规用于临床。
items.insight: 该研究把NFL从单次基线指标推进为早期重复测量的累积暴露和纵向轨迹，提示短期动态变化可能比单点值更贴近ALS疾病活动。对ALS研究者而言，值得跟踪的是：cuNFL和轨迹分组能否在独立队列中外部验证，以及年龄和呼吸功能是否影响其预后价值。但当前证据仍属观察性，不能据此改变临床常规检测策略。

items.abstractZh: 基线神经丝轻链（NFL）可预测肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）结局，但无法概括早期重复测量的生物标志物信息。我们评估了在早期监测窗口内计算的累积NFL暴露（cuNFL）以及纵向NFL轨迹分组是否与前瞻性队列中后续不良事件相关。这项前瞻性研究于2024年1月至2025年1月在中国32个省份纳入ALS患者。在基线、第1个月和第2个月测量血浆NFL。我们使用K均值聚类描述纵向NFL模式，并使用多变量生存模型评估预后关联。逆概率加权和因果森林分析被用作高cuNFL与低cuNFL比较的探索性、混杂校正分析。K均值聚类识别出三个纵向NFL组：低-稳定组（n = 183）、中等组（n = 225）和高-进展组（n = 100）。高-进展组无事件生存期最短（P < 0.001）。cuNFL每增加1个标准差与不良事件发生几率升高相关（校正OR 1.99；95% CI 1.52-2.60；P < 0.001）。使用手稿定义的127事件结局，cuNFL的表观区分度AUC为0.730，基线NFL为0.717。配对DeLong比较无统计学显著性（P = 0.084）。探索性机器学习分析提示高cuNFL与结局的关联因年龄和呼吸功能而异。在该队列中，早期重复NFL测量概括为cuNFL和纵向轨迹分组与短期不良事件相关。这些发现支持对基于纵向NFL的风险分层进行进一步外部验证。它们并未确立因果生物学效应，也未提供常规重复测量的依据。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究以早期重复血浆NFL测量构建累积暴露和纵向轨迹，为ALS短期风险分层提供了新近且具有转化潜力的生物标志物分析框架。

items.title: Splicing modulation of ATXN2 as a therapeutic strategy to regulate Ataxin-2 protein levels in ALS.
items.summary: ATXN2 is associated with an increased risk of Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS), while down-regulation of ATXN2 has been shown to mitigate TDP-43 proteinopathy in ALS models. In this study, we demonstrated that Ataxin-2 protein levels were upregulated in rNLS8 mice following doxycycline withdrawal, which coincided with TDP-43 overexpression, phosphorylation, and aggregation. To reduce Ataxin-2 protein levels, we explored the approach of splicing modulation at the RNA level. Through bioinformatical analysis, we identified an alternative 5' splicing site of ATXN2 in intron 8. This alternative splicing results in an additional 47 base pairs at the 3' end after Exon 8. The insertion of the extra nucleotides causes a frameshift that leads to reduced mRNA production and, consequently, protein levels. Following the discovery of this alternative splicing site, we conducted an antisense oligonucleotide (ASO) micro-walk to screen ASOs targeting this region. We identified ASOs that specifically modulate this splicing, including those that either enhance or inhibit alternative splicing. We validated that the ASOs that promote alternative splicing and reduce constitutive splicing can lower Ataxin-2 protein levels, which in turn decreases TDP-43 aggregation and stress granule formation in a cell-based model of TDP-43 toxicity. Furthermore, we confirmed that reducing Ataxin-2 levels via previously validated ASO delivery ameliorated TDP-43 pathology in rNLS8 mice. The discovery of ATXN2 alternative splicing, along with the confirmation of splicing modulation using ASOs in human cell-based assays, provides evidence for a proof-of-principle strategy to modulate Ataxin-2 protein levels for the treatment of ALS.
items.titleZh: 通过剪接调控ATXN2作为调节ALS中Ataxin-2蛋白水平的治疗策略
items.summaryZh: 该研究在ATXN2内含子8中发现了一个替代5'剪接位点，该位点可产生移码并降低Ataxin-2蛋白水平。研究者通过ASO微步移筛选获得可调控该剪接的ASO，并在细胞模型中验证其可减少TDP-43聚集和应激颗粒形成；在rNLS8小鼠中，降低Ataxin-2水平可改善TDP-43病理。研究提出通过剪接调控降低Ataxin-2是ALS治疗的原理验证性策略。
items.insight: 该研究为ATXN2这一ALS风险基因提供了可成药的RNA剪接调控路径：不是简单敲低ATXN2，而是利用其内含子8的替代5'剪接位点诱导移码，从而降低Ataxin-2蛋白。ASO微步移筛选获得的增强/抑制剪接工具，以及细胞和rNLS8小鼠中的TDP-43病理改善，为后续ASO先导序列优化、递送策略和毒理评估提供了起点。对关注TDP-43蛋白病变上游调控、RNA靶向治疗和ATXN2遗传风险的ALS研究者而言，这是值得跟踪的转化前研究。

items.abstractZh: ATXN2与肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）风险增加相关，而ATXN2的下调已被证明可减轻ALS模型中的TDP-43蛋白病变。在本研究中，我们证明在rNLS8小鼠中，多西环素撤药后Ataxin-2蛋白水平上调，这与TDP-43过表达、磷酸化和聚集同时发生。为降低Ataxin-2蛋白水平，我们探索了在RNA水平进行剪接调控的方法。通过生物信息学分析，我们鉴定了ATXN2内含子8中的一个替代5'剪接位点。该替代剪接导致外显子8之后3'端增加47个碱基对。额外核苷酸的插入引起移码，导致mRNA生成减少，进而降低蛋白水平。在发现该替代剪接位点后，我们进行了反义寡核苷酸（ASO）微步移筛选，以筛选靶向该区域的ASO。我们鉴定出可特异性调控该剪接的ASO，包括增强或抑制替代剪接的ASO。我们验证了促进替代剪接并减少组成型剪接的ASO能够降低Ataxin-2蛋白水平，进而在基于细胞的TDP-43毒性模型中减少TDP-43聚集和应激颗粒形成。此外，我们证实通过先前验证的ASO递送降低Ataxin-2水平可改善rNLS8小鼠中的TDP-43病理。ATXN2替代剪接的发现，以及在人类细胞实验中确认使用ASO进行剪接调控，为调节Ataxin-2蛋白水平以治疗ALS的原理验证策略提供了证据。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近鉴定了ATXN2的替代剪接位点并用ASO在细胞和rNLS8小鼠中验证了降低Ataxin-2、改善TDP-43病理的原理验证策略，对ALS的RNA靶向治疗具有转化价值。

items.title: Identifying candidate therapeutic targets in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis through a transcriptome-wide machine-learning consensus approach for drug repurposing.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a heterogeneous neurodegenerative disease for which effective disease-modifying therapies remain limited. This study aimed to derive internally recurrent ALS-associated transcriptional signatures and generate directionally interpretable drug-repositioning hypotheses using a consensus machine-learning framework. Two publicly available transcriptomic datasets from motor cortex (E-MTAB-2325) and blood (E-TABM-940) were analyzed using four feature-selection methods within 100 repetitions of 4-fold cross-validation. Probes recurrently selected in models achieving an accuracy of at least 0.90 were prioritized and examined using COGENA pathway enrichment and Connectivity Map drug-signature analysis. Fifteen qualifying models were obtained for the motor-cortex dataset and 55 for the blood dataset. No exact prioritized gene or probe identifier was shared between the two top-100 signatures, but pathway-level integration identified complementary evidence involving glial and immune regulation, proteostasis and vesicle trafficking, MAPK-related stress signaling, cytoskeletal and extracellular remodeling, and RNA-related processes. The motor-cortex dataset additionally emphasized astroglial support, glutamate handling, and inclusion-body regulation, whereas the blood dataset highlighted cytokine regulation and directionally heterogeneous immune, mitochondrial, and metabolic signals. Deferoxamine and disulfiram showed the clearest reversal-compatible profiles in motor cortex, whereas yohimbic acid and atovaquone showed reversal-compatible profiles in blood. Ciprofloxacin, prochlorperazine, and a compound group led by androsterone instead showed concordant connectivity. The results provide transparent, hypothesis-generating gene, pathway, and compound priorities, but they do not establish biomarkers, therapeutic efficacy, or clinical suitability and require validation in independent cohorts and experimental ALS models.
items.titleZh: 通过转录组范围机器学习共识方法识别肌萎缩侧索硬化症的候选治疗靶点以用于药物重定位
items.summaryZh: 该研究利用机器学习共识框架分析运动皮层和血液的转录组数据，识别出ALS相关的基因和通路特征，并据此提出药物重定位假设。研究发现两个数据集在基因层面无重叠，但在通路层面存在互补证据，涉及胶质和免疫调节、蛋白稳态、MAPK信号等。研究提名了去铁胺、双硫仑、育亨宾酸、阿托伐醌等候选药物，但强调这些仅为假设，未验证疗效或临床适用性。
items.insight: 这项研究为ALS药物重定位提供了系统性的计算框架和可检验的候选靶点与化合物列表，尽管结果尚属假设生成阶段，但其通路层面的整合分析揭示了运动皮层与血液样本间的互补信息，值得ALS研究者关注以设计后续验证实验。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种异质性神经退行性疾病，目前有效的疾病修饰疗法仍然有限。本研究旨在利用共识机器学习框架，推导内部可重复的ALS相关转录特征，并生成方向可解释的药物重定位假设。研究分析了两个公开可用的转录组数据集，分别来自运动皮层（E-MTAB-2325）和血液（E-TABM-940），在100次重复的4折交叉验证中使用了四种特征选择方法。在准确率至少达到0.90的模型中反复被选中的探针被优先考虑，并通过COGENA通路富集和Connectivity Map药物特征分析进行检验。运动皮层数据集获得了15个合格模型，血液数据集获得了55个。两个前100特征之间没有共享完全相同的优先基因或探针标识符，但通路层面的整合识别出涉及胶质和免疫调节、蛋白稳态和囊泡运输、MAPK相关应激信号、细胞骨架和细胞外重塑以及RNA相关过程的互补证据。运动皮层数据集还强调了星形胶质细胞支持、谷氨酸处理和包涵体调节，而血液数据集则突出了细胞因子调节以及方向异质性的免疫、线粒体和代谢信号。去铁胺和双硫仑在运动皮层中显示出最清晰的反向兼容特征，而育亨宾酸和阿托伐醌在血液中显示出反向兼容特征。环丙沙星、丙氯拉嗪以及以雄酮为首的化合物组则显示出同向连接性。这些结果提供了透明的、产生假设的基因、通路和化合物优先级，但并未建立生物标志物、治疗疗效或临床适用性，需要在独立队列和实验性ALS模型中进行验证。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年发表，利用转录组范围机器学习共识方法为ALS药物重定位提供新候选靶点，具有转化价值但尚需实验验证。

items.title: Pathology of general proprioception in a canine disease model of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Some forms of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) are associated with sequence variants in the superoxide dismutase 1 gene (SOD1). The mechanisms by which these variants contribute to ALS disease pathogenesis are poorly understood. Degenerative myelopathy (DM), a naturally occurring canine disease, shares similarities with some forms of SOD1-associated ALS, especially cases with sensory impairment. While motor pathway involvement in ALS has been extensively studied, sensory pathology has received comparatively less attention. To investigate whether pathology in the general proprioceptive pathway is associated with pelvic limb general proprioceptive ataxia, an early DM sign, we examined sensory system components of this pathway from Pembroke Welsh Corgis with early- and late-stage DM and age-matched controls. The disease was characterized by axonal pathology in the spinocerebellar tracts and the fasciculus gracilis, pronounced accumulation of SOD1-positive inclusions in nucleus thoracicus and dorsal root ganglia (DRG) neurons, and altered SOD1 immunolabeling in dorsal and ventral root axons and ensheathing myelin. Axonal pathology was also observed in a pelvic limb sensory nerve. These findings suggest that pathology in the proprioceptive sensory pathways may play a significant role in general proprioceptive ataxia in DM. Some dogs that were homozygous for the SOD1 risk allele did not develop clinical disease or the associated neuropathology, indicating that other factors in addition to the SOD1 mutation influence disease onset and progression.

items.titleZh: 犬类肌萎缩侧索硬化疾病模型中一般本体感觉的病理学
items.summaryZh: 该研究在自然发生的犬类退行性脊髓病（DM）模型中系统检查了一般本体感觉通路，发现脊髓小脑束和薄束轴突病理、胸核与背根神经节神经元中SOD1阳性包涵体显著积聚，以及背根、腹根和感觉神经的SOD1免疫标记改变。这些感觉通路病理与DM早期后肢本体感觉性共济失调相关。值得注意的是，部分SOD1风险等位基因纯合犬未发病，提示存在其他修饰因素。
items.insight: 该研究将ALS感觉病理学从被忽视的边缘推向机制研究的前沿：DM犬模型不仅复制了SOD1相关ALS的运动病理，还提供了自发出现、可纵向追踪的本体感觉通路病理，有助于解析SOD1包涵体在感觉神经元和背根神经节中的分布规律。纯合风险等位基因犬不发病的现象，为寻找SOD1之外的遗传或环境修饰因子提供了天然对照。对ALS研究者而言，这提示感觉通路病理可能是疾病异质性和表型分层的重要维度，并可能影响生物标志物（如NfL）的解读。

items.abstractZh: 某些形式的肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）与超氧化物歧化酶1基因（SOD1）的序列变异相关。这些变异如何参与ALS疾病发病机制的机制尚不清楚。退行性脊髓病（DM）是一种自然发生的犬类疾病，与某些形式的SOD1相关ALS具有相似性，尤其是伴有感觉障碍的病例。虽然ALS中运动通路的受累已被广泛研究，但感觉病理学受到的关注相对较少。为了探究一般本体感觉通路的病理是否与后肢一般本体感觉性共济失调（DM的早期体征）相关，我们检查了患有早期和晚期DM的彭布罗克威尔士柯基犬以及年龄匹配对照犬中该通路的感觉系统组成部分。该疾病的特征为脊髓小脑束和薄束的轴突病理、胸核和背根神经节（DRG）神经元中SOD1阳性包涵体的显著积聚，以及背根和腹根轴突及包绕髓鞘中SOD1免疫标记的改变。在后肢感觉神经中也观察到轴突病理。这些发现提示，本体感觉感觉通路中的病理可能在DM的一般本体感觉性共济失调中发挥重要作用。一些SOD1风险等位基因纯合子的犬并未发生临床疾病或相关的神经病理，表明除SOD1突变外，其他因素也影响疾病的发病和进展。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究利用自然发生的SOD1相关犬类DM模型，新近揭示了长期被忽视的本体感觉通路病理与SOD1包涵体分布，为ALS感觉障碍机制和表型异质性提供了具有转化价值的动物证据。

items.insight: SMA与ALS同属运动神经元疾病，且皮层投射神经元（尤其皮质脊髓神经元）的退变是ALS的核心病理特征之一。该研究提示SMA模型中同样存在皮层投射神经元的早期成熟障碍与选择性易损性，为理解运动神经元疾病的上下运动神经元共同受累机制提供了跨疾病的比较视角，值得ALS研究者关注其是否共享类似的易损性通路。
